newsitem.title: CHINA: Jin Jiang Tower to conduct bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Jin Jiang Tower to conduct bonus issue.

text.p: Shanghai Jin Jiang Tower Co will offer shareholders one-for-10 bonus shares based on the firm's 1996 net profit and another one-for-10 bonus shares from its capital reserves, a statement said on Friday.
Shareholders at a meeting on Thursday approved the plan proposed by the firm's board of directors, the company statement published in the Shanghai Securities News said.
Details of the bonus issue will be announced later, the statement said.
Jin Jiang Tower earlier posted a net profit of 53.916 million yuan for 1996 against 53.423 million yuan for 1995 based on the domestic accounting standards.

The company did not give net profit figures under international accounting standards. But it posted pre-tax profit of 75.242 million yuan for 1996 against 86.887 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.
